name: Girls Be Ambitious!
original_name: ガールズbeアンビシャス！
source:
Kaidou Gakuen was located at the foot of a mountain and it was split into two by a huge wall. One was a celebrity school for children from the upper classes, while the other was a school for the common people. It was forbidden for the students from each school to intermingle with the other. Haruto attended the common school and planned to sneak into the celebrity school to get a glimpse of the hated upper class students. However, he got lost in the darkness of the night. Following a light, he came upon a botanical garden and had a fateful meeting with a girl from the upper class. Can one’s life be determined alone by where they were born and what titles they have?

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2013/08/01/august-2013-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
海棠学园坐落在山脚下，被一堵巨大的墙壁一分为二。一边是上流阶层子女就读的名流学校，另一边是普通人的学校。两所学校的学生被禁止交往。春斗就读于普通学校，计划潜入名流学校一睹那些令人厌恶的上流学生。然而，他在夜色中迷了路。循着一束光，他来到了一座植物园，与一位上流阶层的女孩有了命运般的相遇。一个人的人生真的能仅凭出生地和头衔来决定吗？

[来自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2013/08/01/august-2013-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
